name: Proposal for a decision (as a whole)
title: PROPOSAL FOR A DECISION on the number and numerical strength of the interparliamentary delegations
part_text:
The European Parliament has set how many of its members will sit on each of its friendship groups with other countries and regions. These groups meet with politicians from outside the European Union to talk about shared issues. The decision lists each group, from small ones like Iraq with 8 members to large ones like the United States with 64, and fixes those numbers. It replaces the earlier list from 2019 and takes effect immediately.

- Each country or regional friendship group now has a fixed number of Parliament members, from 8 to 78.
- It affects the members who join these groups and the politicians they meet outside the European Union.
- The new numbers apply straight away and replace the 2019 list.
